fusions.name: Blood Scent
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Fires a bolt that deals 9 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Its damage rises by 10% per affliction the target carries, to a maximum of 40%.

fusions.name: Closing Circle
fusions.desc: Deals 34 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Rising Hunger
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Taste Remembered
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
